data.sub: Lucknow mein ITI students ke deekshant mein bole PM Modi

chat.say: Suna AI job nahi chheen sakta?
Haan par skill honi chahiye, AI se nahi mujhse daro!

data.asar: Degree se zyada ab skill par dhyan dena padega bhai.
data.caption:
AI aur job ki nayi update aa gayi hai bhai log! 🚀

• Lucknow mein ITI students ke deekshant mein bole PM Modi
• Kaha ki koi AI aapka rozgar nahi chheen sakta
• Jiske paas skill hai, uske liye job ki tension nahi
• Shahid Path par dopahar 12 se raat 10 baje tak traffic diversion

Ab AI se zyada khud ko upgrade karne ki zarurat hai!

Comment mein batao: Aapka AI ko lekar kya plan hai?
